========================================
#embed as the only initializer element
========================================

char d[]={
#embed "x" limit(5)
};

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (init_declarator
      declarator: (array_declarator
        declarator: (identifier))
      value: (initializer_list
        (preproc_call
          directive: (preproc_directive)
          argument: (preproc_arg))))))

========================================
#embed between other initializer elements
========================================

char d[]={1,
#embed <x>
, 2};

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (init_declarator
      declarator: (array_declarator
        declarator: (identifier))
      value: (initializer_list
        (number_literal)
        (preproc_call
          directive: (preproc_directive)
          argument: (preproc_arg))
        (number_literal)))))

========================================
Plain initializer lists still parse
========================================

int a[] = {1, 2, 3};
struct P p = {.x = 1, .y = 2};

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (init_declarator
      declarator: (array_declarator
        declarator: (identifier))
      value: (initializer_list
        (number_literal)
        (number_literal)
        (number_literal))))
  (declaration
    type: (struct_specifier
      name: (type_identifier))
    declarator: (init_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      value: (initializer_list
        (initializer_pair
          designator: (field_designator
            (field_identifier))
          value: (number_literal))
        (initializer_pair
          designator: (field_designator
            (field_identifier))
          value: (number_literal))))))

========================================
#embed as an expression operand
========================================

const int x = 1 +
#embed "b"
;

const int y =
#embed <c> limit(4)
+ 2;

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (type_qualifier)
    (primitive_type)
    (init_declarator
      (identifier)
      (binary_expression
        (number_literal)
        (preproc_embed
          (string_literal
            (string_content))))))
  (declaration
    (type_qualifier)
    (primitive_type)
    (init_declarator
      (identifier)
      (binary_expression
        (preproc_embed
          (system_lib_string)
          (identifier)
          (embed_parameter_list
            (number_literal)))
        (number_literal)))))
